SUBJECT:  APPROVE NOMINATION FOR APPOINTMENT TO THE PALMDALE
  ENHANCED INFRASTRUCTURE FINANCING DISTRICT PUBLIC
  FINANCING AUTHORITY

ISSUE
Approve nomination for appointment to the Palmdale Enhanced Infrastructure Financing
District (EIFD) Public Financing Authority.

RECOMMENDATION
Approve nomination for appointment to the Palmdale EIFD Public Financing Authority as
follows:

  1. Appoint Kathryn Mac Laren-Gomez nominated by Mayor and City Council to serve
  as Committee Member on the Palmdale EIFD Public Financing Authority:

BACKGROUND

At the June 1, 2021 City Council meeting, the City Council approved Resolution CC 2021-
044 to establish the Palmdale EIFD and a Public Financing Authority. The primary goal
of the Palmdale EIFD is to attract new private investment and accelerate development in
key areas of the city, helping create new jobs, housing opportunities and local and
regional transportation options for the region.

The Public Financing Authority will review and facilitate public hearings on the
Infrastructure Financing Plan (IFP) for the Palmdale EIFD. The Plan will include tax
increment revenue projection updates, infrastructure to be financed with Palmdale EIFD
funds, caps to the maximum tax increment revenue and bond authorization, and district
formation and election cost information. Prior to the final approval of an IFP by the Public
Financing Authority, the City Council will have an opportunity to review and approve the
Plan.
 Report to Mayor and City Council
Re: Approval of Palmdale EIFD PFA Appointments
June 22, 2021
Page 2

DISCUSSION

Under EIFD law, the EIFD Public Financing Authority is the governing board of the
Palmdale EIFD. The Public Financing Authority’s membership shall be comprised of two
members of the City Council, a public member selected by the Council, one member of
the County Board of Supervisors, and a member of the public selected by the County.
Members shall serve at the pleasure of their respective appointing legislative bodies.

A Notice of Vacancy was advertised in the AV Press as required and advertised for
interested citizens to apply. The Communications division also provided a press release
to the public, including the application submittal deadline. The Classified Ad and the
application were made available on the City’s website as well as in the Office of the City
Clerk. Staff received two (2) applications by the June 21, 2021, application submittal
deadline. Ordinance No. 1561 allows for Mayor and City Councilmembers to nominate a
member to a Board or Commission. Should candidates nominated by the Mayor and
Councilmembers fail to be approved by a majority vote, another candidate will be
nominated until someone is approved by the Council.

FISCAL IMPACT

There is no fiscal impact associated with this item, as member positions do not receive
compensation for service.
